test_title: RRB NTPC CBT-I Official Paper (Held On: 27 Mar 2021 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
The curved surface area of a cylindrical pillar is 66 m² and its volume is 231 m³. Find the measure of its radius.

(Take pi={22over7})
solution:
**Given:**

Curved surface area of a cylindrical pillar = 66 m²

Volume of the cylindrical pillar = 231 m³

π = 22/7

**Formula Used:**

Curved Surface Area (CSA) of a cylinder = 2πrh

Volume (V) of a cylinder = πr²h

**Calculation:**

From CSA, 2πrh = 66

⇒ 2 × 22/7 × r × h = 66

⇒ 44rh = 66 × 7

⇒ 44rh = 462

⇒ rh = 462/44

⇒ rh = 10.5

From Volume, πr²h = 231

⇒ 22/7 × r² × h = 231

⇒ 22r²h/7 = 231

⇒ 22r²h = 231 × 7

⇒ 22r²h = 1617

⇒ r²h = 1617/22

⇒ r²h = 73.5

We have rh = 10.5

⇒ r × 10.5 = 73.5

⇒ r = 73.5/10.5

⇒ r = 7 m

**The correct answer is option 1.**
